subject.title: [Bug]: Windows Scheduled Task gateway restart/health becomes inconsistent after ready

question: Should this issue remain the broad canonical tracker while narrower Windows Scheduled Task repairs land, or should maintainers split/retire it after choosing a narrower canonical path?
rationale: Current main fixes important subsets but not the full reported behavior, and overlapping open issues/PRs need maintainer coordination before another automated fix lane is safe.

options.title: Keep Broad Canonical
options.body: Keep this issue open as the broad tracker and land focused schtasks repairs against the narrower linked issues and PRs with live Windows proof.

options.title: Split To Narrow Canonicals
options.body: Move each remaining symptom to a narrower canonical issue such as the direct /Run failure and foreground-listener launch-evidence reports, then close this only after linking preserved context.

options.title: Pause Until Live Repro
options.body: Do not promote implementation until a maintainer or contributor provides a current-main native Windows Scheduled Task reproduction bundle.

recommendation.title: Keep Broad Canonical
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as the broad tracker and land focused schtasks repairs against the narrower linked issues and PRs with live Windows proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The issue is currently assigned to vincentkoc and he recently owned the related restart-health fix.
